name: lark
description: Connect Lark to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Lark MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Lark to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with docs and team messaging using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Lark workspace.
Find anything in Lark that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review docs and team messaging in Lark.
